_note: Virtual exhibitions: shows designed in Open Studio for a room that exists only here (space/synth.js draws it). 'artist' shows are designed by the artist in their studio; 'curated' ones by Open Studio's curator, across artists, in a chosen order, like a playlist. Works are app slugs, in walking order.

shows.title: Celebration
text: New paintings from 2024 to 2026, hung by the artist in a room that exists only here: the large gatherings first, then the flowers, small and close together, then the figures.
A demo of the exhibitions artists will design in Open Studio: choose a room, a wall colour and the order of the works, and the room is built around them.

shows.title: The Green Hour
text: Seven artists who never shared a wall, hung together for the hour when the light turns green: Monet's gardens, Van Gogh's irises, Matisse's green stripe, Berthe Morisot on the water, a storm of Victor Hugo's ink, Hilma af Klint's childhood in pink and green, and Elad Amsalem's paintings of now.
Curated by hand for Open Studio, in an order meant to be walked from the door to the far wall and back. No algorithm chose these works.
